rationale.rules-based-checks: OPA policy engine enforces deterministic rules over proposed agent actions.
rationale.risk-routing: escalates agent actions to human review based on composite risk scores.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: aligns enforcement with EU AI Act, ISO 42001, and NIST RMF.
rationale.framework: proposes cloud-native policy engine architecture with OPA and service mesh.
rationale.built-system: implemented as a microservice and evaluated on three multi-agent workloads.
rationale.agentic: governs autonomous, multi-step tool calls generated by AI agents.
rationale.general-ai: governance targets general enterprise agentic AI, not specifically software development.
rationale.metrics: defines composite risk scores measuring security, compliance, and privacy.
rationale.risk-security: contributes and evaluates a mitigation for prompt injection and tool misuse.
rationale.method-experiment: evaluated in controlled multi-agent workloads against a baseline without policy.
